landing.eyebrow: For potters, weavers, woodturners and makers
landing.subtitle: Take about 12 photos of a handmade piece with your phone. Vitrina turns them into a store where customers spin it, see every side and order on WhatsApp.
landing.hero.note3d: Real-time 3D illustration. In your store, buyers spin your real photos.
landing.hero.noteFrames: Illustration drawn in 24 frames. Drag the piece.
landing.hero.aria: Interactive 3D illustration of a handmade piece on a turntable. Drag or use the left and right arrow keys to spin it.
landing.crafts: Ceramics|Backstrap weaving|Woodturning|Silver filigree|Basketry|Alpaca knits|Embroidery|Leatherwork|Blown glass|Retablos|Carved gourds|Hand-poured candles
landing.story.title: From twelve photos to a piece buyers can turn in their hands.
landing.story.s1.title: Walk around it
landing.story.s1.body: Put the piece on any table and take about 12 photos as you circle it. The app shows which angles are still missing.
landing.story.s2.title: We clean, never invent
landing.story.s2.body: Backgrounds are removed and frames aligned. Every frame is checked against your original photo.
landing.story.s3.title: Buyers spin it
landing.story.s3.body: Share one link. Buyers drag to see every side and order on WhatsApp in one tap.
landing.fidelity.body: Generative AI can make any pot look perfect. That is exactly why we never use it on your pieces. Each processed frame is compared with its original photo, and any view that drifts from reality is thrown out, so buyers receive exactly what they saw.
landing.fidelity.never2: No invented materials, origin or sizes
landing.fidelity.never3: Your listing only says what you told us
landing.fidelity.threshold: Frames below the line are discarded
landing.fidelity.dropped: Frame 08 was “improved” and drifted from the photo, so it never reaches the store.
landing.fidelity.demo: Illustrative check on the demo piece.
landing.features.title: Built for the way artisans actually sell.
landing.features.wa.title: Orders land in WhatsApp
landing.features.wa.body: No cart and no new app to learn. One tap opens a chat with the piece and the price already written.
landing.features.i18n.title: Speaks English and Spanish
landing.features.i18n.body: Your store and listings come in both languages, so a buyer in Lima and one in Chicago read about the same piece.
landing.features.key.title: No account, just a secret link
landing.features.key.body: No passwords to forget. You manage your store with a private edit link you keep on your phone.
landing.features.brand.title: A brand from your own piece
landing.features.brand.body: We pull a palette from your photos. Every product you add inherits it.
landing.proof.title: The example store is open. Go spin something.
landing.proof.body: A demo store open to anyone: no code, no sign-up. Its pieces went through the real pipeline, so it is exactly what your buyers would see.
landing.proof.noCode: Open to everyone, no access code
landing.cta.title: Your piece deserves more than one flat photo.
landing.cta.body: Try the whole flow right now with sample photos, processed live. It takes about a minute.
footer.built: Built for the AWS Zero to Shipped hackathon.
capture.title: Shoot your piece
capture.subtitle: Place the piece on a plain surface and walk around it: about 12 photos, one per marker.
capture.tip1: Use soft daylight and a plain background.
capture.tip2: Keep the piece centered and at the same distance in every shot.
capture.tip3: Avoid blur: hold still and tap to focus.
